definitions.explanation: Derived from a single fertilized egg, used primarily to describe identical twins who share the same genetic material.

examples.japanese: {一卵性|いちらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ}。
{二人|ふたり}は{一卵性|いちらんせい}の{双子|ふたご}だから{見分|みわ}けがつかない。
examples.english: The two are identical twins, so I can't tell them apart.

examples.japanese: {一卵性|いちらんせい}の{双子|ふたご}は{遺伝子|いでんし}が{同|おな}じだ。
examples.english: Identical twins have the same genes.

notes:
{一卵性|いちらんせい} is a scientific/medical term for monozygotic.

COMMON USES:
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ}: identical twins (formal)
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}の{双子|ふたご}: identical twins

COMPARISON:
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}: identical/monozygotic (from one egg)
- {二卵性|にらんせい}: fraternal/dizygotic (from two eggs)

NOTE:
{双子|ふたご} alone just means "twins" without specifying identical or fraternal.
